/quality/ncrs/1.issueDescription: Bore diameter 0.05 mm over tolerance on 3 trial pieces.
/quality/ncrs/1.containmentAction: All suspect stock quarantined and tagged; 100% sorting of the affected lots started.
/quality/ncrs/1.rootCause: 5-why analysis: worn tooling and an unmonitored process parameter allowed the drift to reach the customer lot.
/quality/ncrs/1.correctiveAction: Worn tooling replaced, process re-validated, three consecutive lots passed with zero findings.
/quality/ncrs/1.preventiveAction: Tool-life counters and SPC alarms rolled out to all similar machining lines.

capaActions.actionDescription: Replace the worn tool and re-validate the first-off piece.
Add tool-life counter and an SPC alarm on the critical dimension.

/quality/ncrs/1/history.newValue: All suspect stock quarantined and tagged; 100% sorting of the affected lots started.

/quality/deviations/1.deviationDescription: Accept forgings with parting-line flash up to 0.6 mm for the trial lot.
/quality/deviations/1.technicalImpact: Flash is removed in the next machining step.

Customer accepts the deviation for this lot only.
